evidence_timing: Post-outcome extension after P03, P13 classical, and P04; not prospectively blinded.

research_questions.title: Compact RBF transfer
research_questions.question: Can a small RBF classifier identify supported chemicals on excluded instruments and unseen physical masters competitively with established baselines?

research_questions.title: SOM organization
research_questions.question: Do SOM neighbourhoods organize by chemistry or acquisition conditions and how stable is this organization?

research_questions.title: Repeated-view consistency
research_questions.question: Are same-master cross-instrument views more consistent while chemical distinctions and correctness are retained?

research_questions.title: Preprocessing effects
research_questions.question: Does universal smoothing or baseline correction improve prototype-based transfer without losing chemical distinctions?

research_questions.title: Independent sample efficiency
research_questions.question: How do independent master counts and prototype budgets affect performance and cost?

research_questions.title: Applicability and error detection
research_questions.question: Does distance from prototypes flag held-instrument errors better than confidence alone?

research_questions.title: Prototype mechanism ablations
research_questions.question: Does SOM centre organization or an RBF head improve an otherwise matched pipeline?

models.description: Weighted K-means Gaussian RBF with regularized multinomial output

Fresh Random Forest and Extra Trees fits on matching learning subsets

RBF versus linear head on identical role-correct frozen neural features
